frontmatter.name: speckit-converge
frontmatter.description: Assess the current codebase against the feature's spec, plan, and tasks, then append any remaining unbuilt work as new tasks to tasks.md so implement can complete it.

frontmatter.name: speckit-specify
frontmatter.description: Create or update the feature specification from a natural language feature description.

frontmatter.name: speckit-tasks
frontmatter.description: Generate an actionable, dependency-ordered tasks.md for the feature based on available design artifacts.

frontmatter.name: speckit-checklist
frontmatter.description: Generate a custom checklist for the current feature based on user requirements.
frontmatter.compatibility: Requires spec-kit project structure with .specify/ directory

frontmatter.name: speckit-clarify
frontmatter.description: Identify underspecified areas in the current feature spec by asking up to 5 highly targeted clarification questions and encoding answers back into the spec.
frontmatter.compatibility: Requires spec-kit project structure with .specify/ directory

frontmatter.name: speckit-implement
frontmatter.description: Execute the implementation plan by processing and executing all tasks defined in tasks.md
frontmatter.compatibility: Requires spec-kit project structure with .specify/ directory

frontmatter.name: speckit-constitution
frontmatter.description: Create or update the project constitution from interactive or provided principle inputs.
frontmatter.compatibility: Requires spec-kit project structure with .specify/ directory
